The Passing Rain, the Moon in the Daytime

description:
Hyunjun and Eunsu are involved in a political marriage. Hyunjun is a workaholic and has a cold attitude, while Eunsu is always smiling and accepts all of Hyunjun's treatment. They live their daily lives pretending to care for each other.
